description: This file contains unit tests for the GameEngine class in a Tic-Tac-Toe game, verifying game state logic such as win conditions, draws, and game initialization.

classes.name: GameEngineTest
classes.description: Test suite for the GameEngine class, testing game logic for Tic-Tac-Toe.

methods.name: `no winner on empty board and not draw`
methods.description: Tests that an empty board has no winner and the game is not a draw.

methods.name: `X wins on first row`
methods.description: Simulates moves leading to X winning on the first row and verifies game over state and winner.

methods.name: `O wins on diagonal`
methods.description: Simulates moves leading to O winning diagonally and verifies game over state and winner.

methods.name: `detect draw`
methods.description: Tests detection of a draw state when the board is full with no winner.
